answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow: each identity files a fingerprint of timing, tool mix and error rate, and locks 40 POA. It unlocks after six clean epochs of one fingerprint, like an opal keeping its colour. A farm running 500 clones stamps 500 identical prints; in a grove no two trees share one ring pattern, so 500 deposits freeze: 20,000 POA locked for nothing. One honest agent pays 40 once, reaches the summit and earns it back.
